game.q: the merchant tells his helpers to let the debt go. what reason does he give?
opts: “maybe God will let us go too.”
“they’ll pay us back in kindness someday.”

wrong.biz: smart thinking, but that wasn’t his reason.
wrong.later: a kind hope. his was bigger than that.

game.right: YES. he let it go, and hoped for the same.

end.line: a merchant let debts go. on the day it counted, that one habit carried him.
